secrets.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL
secrets.description: Supabase project URL (e.g. https://xxxxx.supabase.co). Get from Supabase dashboard → Project Settings → API.

secrets.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase anon/public API key. Get from Supabase dashboard → Project Settings → API.

secrets.name: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase service role key (server-side only). Get from Supabase dashboard → Project Settings → API.

secrets.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID
secrets.description: Google OAuth client ID for Google Business Profile integration. Get from Google Cloud Console → Credentials.

secrets.name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET
secrets.description: Google OAuth client secret. Get from Google Cloud Console → Credentials.

secrets.name: GOOGLE_PLACES_API_KEY
secrets.description: Google Places API key for place lookups. Get from Google Cloud Console → Credentials.

secrets.name: META_APP_SECRET
secrets.description: Meta/Facebook app secret for OAuth. Get from Meta for Developers → App Settings.

secrets.name: ADMIN_EMAILS
secrets.description: Comma-separated admin email addresses for admin panel access.

secrets.name: ADMIN_SESSION_SECRET
secrets.description: Secret key for signing admin session tokens. Falls back to SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY if not set.
